findings.analysis: Correctness items mostly check source fact presence and exact values. They do not explicitly test whether 36-hour remaining time and 48-hour event window have the same origin, or whether absence of a recorded response implies no response occurred.

R14 explicitly permits identifiable recommendations and decisions for approval, but evidence penalizes suggested response levels, proposed sign-off roles and decision requests as unsupported facts. Some other listed violations (year and time origins) may be valid; mixed valid and invalid evidence must not be treated as all trustworthy.

Small precision/metadata omissions can receive substantial penalties while weak inference is not checked adequately. Do not alter per-case weights to match labels; revise general coverage then validate on a new frozen version.

policy: No manual changes to scores or human labels.
